'''Barab I''' was a dark, murky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Barab system/Legends|Barab system]] of the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], the planet was largely avoided by spacers due to the fearsome natives known as the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]].

==Description==
[[File:Barab_l.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Barab I]]
A murky world shrouded in darkness, Barab I's star was a dim [[Barab (star)/Legends|red dwarf]] that made the planet very dark. The planet orbited the star within less than 125 million kilometers, and the planet had a day period of sixty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]. During the day, the planet was [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] with gamma, ultraviolet and infrared rays, forcing all life on the planet to delve underground or cocoon itself else it be destroyed. Therefore, all species were nocturnal and adapted to hunt or forage in the evening without the risk of radiation poisoning. Because the world's oceans and standing water evaporated during the extremely hot day period, sudden torrential downpours soaked the planet at night, forcing the natives to hunt quickly or risk being washed away.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
[[File:Barabel-EotECR.png|thumb|left|180px|Barabels were native to Barab I]]
While members of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] species had managed to travel offplanet throughout various points in history aboard passing ships, the species did not develop its own means of space travel and largely remained on Barab I. Circa [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]] representatives of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] visited the world, which was embroiled in a bloody [[Barabel War|civil war]]. Creating a [[Neutral Jedi Zone|zone of neutrality]] around their landing site the Jedi, led by [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Noga-ta]], managed to engage the two warring parties and end the war peacefully after thousands of years of struggle. Grateful for the Jedi intervention, the Barabel gave the Jedi their undying respect, deifying their arrival and worshiping them for generations.<ref name="PotJS">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Over the next few centuries, the Barabel began exporting goods from their world, while remaining largely separate from the [[galactic community]] at large. Exporting [[Barabel fruit|exotic fruits]] and [[Barab ore|ores]], the planet managed to create a small economy which helped bring in tools and weapons desperately needed on the world.<ref name="TFR" /><ref name="KOTORII" /> Not only did the Barabel use imported weapons for defense against their top predator, the fearsome [[durgolosk]], but also for work as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="GATORW" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across the galaxy between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] secretly dispatched one of their own members, Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], to the planet during the early stages of the war to conduct a classified mission.<ref name="WS">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> While the planet was not attacked during the war, it was annexed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the end of the conflict and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Paro Lanto]] was placed in charge of the world. During this time, [[Planetary Safaris Inc.]] began sending ships to the world and poaching swiftly became a problem. The combined efforts of the Barabel and Imperial officer [[Osted Alater]] quickly put an end to the illegal hunting and the Barabel established the [[Alater-ka]] [[Alater-ka Spaceport|spaceport]] on the world in honor of their comrade.<ref name="FHI" />

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated the world from the Imperials, several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Barabel joined Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] to help defend the Republic from the threat of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Barabel [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] traveled to defend her world from the invaders, only to find and destroy a [[slaveship]] carrying a large part of the world's population. Torn at the thought that she had slaughtered her own people, Sebatyne later discovered that many of the Barabel had hidden underground as the Yuuzhan Vong ravaged their world and left it in ruin.<ref name="SBS" />
